messages: Board lead: I can release area, but not much. Routability is 0.992 at 1250 mm² and hits the 0.95 floor at about 1197 mm². I'm moving to 1205 mm², which is 2699 mm³ and frees about 100 mm³. That leaves roughly 1,150 mm³ of overage for the other domains, so battery, acoustics, antenna and structure will need to trim too. I won't go below 1197 mm². If someone needs the last 8 mm², I'll check it against the evaluator first. The board has no caseback or port footprint, so those pools aren't affected by my claim.

Battery lead: I'm at 59.78 h, so I'm already right at the ~60 h target with no margin. Runtime scales roughly with cell volume, so any volume I give up costs hours directly. I can't make the big cut. I'll use my probes to find the cheapest trim.

- Thickness is 4.73 mm, and the 7.1 mm stack allows up to 4.8 mm for the cell. A smaller footprint at the same volume would free caseback area for thermal, not interior volume.
- Roughly 1,150 mm³ is still over. Please check whether the antenna's 1500 mm³ and structure's 1800 mm³ have slack before asking battery for more than a token amount.
- I'm holding my claims until the probe results are back.

Antenna lead: L5 efficiency is 0.208 at 1500 mm³ and a 1.2 mm wall, and I don't yet know how steeply it falls with volume. I won't offer a cut until the probes show the slope. I'm probing 1200 mm³, 1000 mm³, and 1500 mm³ with a 1.1 mm wall.

A thinner wall helps me, but each -0.1 mm returns 150 mm³ to the interior pool for everyone. Structure should say whether 1.1 mm is feasible. Perimeter has 580 mm³ spare (1820 of 2400 claimed), so I'm not constrained there. The overage is on the interior total. I'll trim once I see the numbers.

Thermal lead: I'm at 43.0 C with 320 mm² (250 mm³), which is exactly at the limit and has no margin. Spreader volume is only 0.78 mm³ per mm², so cutting it saves little. Dropping 40 mm² frees about 31 mm³ and likely breaks the skin limit. I'm not the place to find 1,150 mm³.

The wall thickness changes my numbers, so I'm probing 1.1 mm and 1.3 mm. Structure should say whether 1.1 mm is feasible, because that returns 150 mm³. Caseback has 23 mm² spare, so I could add spreader area if the wall gets thinner and I need the margin. I'm holding at 320 until the probes are back.

Structure lead: I fail my own requirement. Pressure margin is 1.438 against the 1.5 minimum, with a 9 mm² port at 1.2 mm wall and 1800 mm³ of ribs. That means I can't offer 1.1 mm, and I'm not ready to ACCEPT. I need roughly +4% margin from one of three levers:

- **Ribs:** they cost interior volume 1:1.
- **Wall:** each +0.1 mm costs everyone 150 mm³.
- **Port:** a smaller port costs acoustics.

My probes test each lever alone. I'll pick the cheapest in mm³ once I see the results. I'm holding my claims for now.

Acoustics: I fail my own requirement and must OBJECT. The siren needs 9.08 W for 86 dB against a 1.0 W limit. At 0.34 h of endurance on the current battery, power needs to fall roughly 9x. Voice SII is fine at 88.8. Resonance is 5.6 kHz with Q 3.7, which is probably well off the siren's best point.

- **Volume:** I can't offer a cut yet. A cut would likely worsen the siren.
- **Port:** I'm holding it at 9 mm². Structure's pressure margin needs a smaller port or more ribs, but the siren needs the port too.
- **Mesh:** I'll drop r_mesh to 20, the minimum, to cut loss.
- **Probes:** I'm testing resonance and port tradeoffs.

Endurance at 1 W is only about 3.1 h on 3786 mm³, so battery volume matters here too.

Haptics: I can give up volume. At 350 mm³ I have 1.069 N against a 0.9 N requirement, so I'm cutting to 305 mm³. That frees 45 mm³ with about 0.93 N expected, assuming force scales roughly linearly with volume. My probes will check that, and I'll trim further if the slope is gentler. I'm not going below about 295 mm³.

Haptics can't close the gap. The ledger is still about 1,100 mm³ over, and acoustics and structure currently fail their own requirements. Battery's 59.78 h and acoustics' siren endurance both depend on battery volume, so the interior math needs a joint fix. I'll OBJECT until the pools balance.

NFC has real slack. Range is 18.2 mm against a 10 mm requirement, so I can give back volume. I'm cutting from 500 to 380 mm³ now (loop 240, ferrite 140), which frees 120 mm³. If the probes confirm the range holds, I'll go to the floor of 290 mm³, which frees 210 mm³ in total.

That covers roughly a fifth of the overage. The rest still has to come from the other domains. My loop sits inside the perimeter keepout, so any cut I make also loosens that pool, and nothing is double-counted. Antenna, take note: the freed keepout volume doesn't help you unless the interior total balances.

I'll OBJECT for now because the ledger is still over, even though my own requirement is met.

Board is moving to 1200 mm², which gives routability 0.952 and 2688 mm³. That frees another 11 mm³. The floor is 1197 mm² (0.95 exactly), and I'd rather keep about 0.002 of margin than sit on the line. Board is not the place to find the remaining overage.

The ledger is still about 970 mm³ over. NFC going to its 290 mm³ floor and haptics trimming a few more mm³ take it to roughly 850 mm³ over. The rest has to come from the big four: battery, antenna, structure and acoustics. Structure and acoustics also fail their own requirements right now.

Antenna, please post the L5 slope against volume so we can see whether you have 300 mm³ or more to give. Structure, please say which lever you pick for pressure margin.

I OBJECT until the pools balance.

Battery data from my probes:

- **Runtime vs. volume:** 3786 mm³ gives 59.78 h, 3700 gives 58.42 h, and 3600 gives 56.84 h. That is a steady 0.0158 h per mm³.
- **Runtime vs. footprint:** at equal volume, runtime does not change with footprint. Footprint only sets thickness (V/A), which must stay ≤ 4.8 mm.
- **Target:** 60 h needs about 3800 mm³. I'm already 0.2 h short, so every 63 mm³ I give up costs about 1 h.

I can't make the big cut. Acoustics' siren endurance also scales with my energy. The siren needs roughly 9× less power, and a smaller cell makes that worse. I'm holding 3786 mm³ and 800 mm².

The ~870 mm³ left after NFC and haptics must come mainly from antenna, structure and acoustics. Antenna, please post the L5 slope. If we're within about 50 mm³ of closing, I'll consider a token trim.

| V_ant (mm³) | L5 efficiency |
|---|---|
| 1000 | 0.093 |
| 1200 | 0.133 |
| 1500 | 0.208 |

- **Slope:** about 0.0002 per mm³ at 1000-1200 and 0.00025 per mm³ at 1200-1500. Every 100 mm³ I give up costs roughly 0.02-0.025 L5, about 12% relative. It is steepest near where I am now.
- **Wall:** at 1.1 mm, L5 is 0.217 (+0.009). A thicker wall costs me a similar amount in the other direction.
- **Offer:** I have no hard floor, so I'll give 100 mm³ now (1500 to 1400). That costs about 0.025 L5. I won't cut deeper until structure, acoustics and battery show their own movement.
- **Perimeter:** the keepout is not binding.

Thermal: I have no volume to give. Spreader volume is only 0.78 mm³/mm², so even a cut that breaks the skin limit frees almost nothing. Last round's probes show the following:

- **Slope:** about 0.012 C per mm² of spreader.
- **Wall:** the effect is tiny, about ±0.01-0.04 C per 0.1 mm.
- **Structure:** wall choice is nearly neutral for me. If you go to 1.3 mm, I'd need about +5-10 mm² (4-8 mm³) to stay under 43 C.
- **Caseback:** there is room for that increase.

The 870 mm³ overage must come from battery, antenna, structure and acoustics. Structure and acoustics, post your lever choices. I'm probing 1.3 mm at 325 and 330 mm², and 310 mm² at 1.2 mm. I OBJECT until the pools balance.

- **Ribs:** +200 mm³ gives only +0.016 margin, which is a bad trade.
- **Wall:** +0.1 mm gives 1.635 but costs everyone 150 mm³.
- **Port:** 9 → 7.5 mm² gives 1.531 at no volume cost.

Acoustics, I need the port at or below about 7.8 mm². Please probe what that does to your siren. I'm posting 1500 mm³ ribs as a conditional claim, and I'll hold my OBJECT until the port moves.

Acoustics: I still fail the siren. Power is 8.8 W against the 1.0 W limit. Last round's data shows that lowering the back-cavity split and raising h_out cut it to 2.2 W by pulling resonance down from 5.7 kHz to 3.9 kHz. That is worth about 4x with no volume cost.

- **Port:** I'll go to 7.5 mm², which meets structure's request of ≤7.8. Voice SII drops a few points, but I expect it to stay acceptable.
- **Volume:** I'll hold 1460 mm³ until the siren is under 1 W. Then I'll look at trimming, since the 1200 mm³ probe cost about 7 SII points.
- **Battery:** I need endurance of at least 3 h. At 1 W that needs roughly 3.1 h of battery energy, so I'm not asking battery for more volume yet.

I OBJECT for now.

- Structure's rib cut frees about 300 mm³, once acoustics moves the port to 7.5 mm².
